products.product_description: MyChai Chai Tea Concentrate Original. Product is packaged in plastic (HDPE) 1/2gallon bottle, cap has a foil liner that is induction sealed during the bottling process. Shelf stable 3 year expiration from date of manufacture. Ingredients: Water, Sugar, Organic Black Tea, Organic Spices, Molasses, Vanilla Extract, Citric Acid, Natural Flavors. Made by: MyChai, Inc. 1110 SE Centennial St. Suite 6, Bend, OR 97702 USAGE: Please use 1:1 with milk or soy. Up until fall of 2023, expiration dates were 2 years from the date of production. In the fall of 2023 expiration dates were extended an additional year to 3 years from the production date.
